experiments.name: hierarchical_pooling
experiments.disposition: E1, PROMOTED 2026-08-16: replaces the goals component's hardcoded pseudo-count-4 shrinkage with a hierarchical Poisson attack/defence whose pooling variance is fitted by EM, and which measures attack against the defences actually faced. Blend {goals 0.0, elo 0.40, xg 0.40, pooled 0.20} -- exactly the blend the A/B measured. A/B on the pinned window (n=26,969, evaluation_hash 2c9396c63ee078449c6f, identical to promotion_baseline.json): 1X2 Brier 0.611777->0.611016 (-0.000762), log-loss 1.020406->1.019376 (-0.001029), OU2.5 +0.000277 (inside the 0.0010 tolerance -- a deliberate trade of totals accuracy for 1X2), BTTS -0.000069. Time splits 3/3 wins, worst delta -0.000603. Post-promotion full-window validation: accuracy 49.0%->49.3%, Brier 0.6118->0.6110, --gate PASS. Fitted sigma_attack 0.194 vs sigma_defence 0.150. Baseline deliberately NOT re-pinned: promote_baseline.py refuses ('gate already passes; nothing to re-baseline') because its doctrine covers population changes and forced regressions, not ratcheting after an improvement -- so the gate still references pre-E1 metrics and tolerates ~0.0018 Brier of drift. See docs/model_improvements_changelog.md and plans/club_soccer_uncertainty_experiment.md

experiments.name: bootstrap_spread_probe
experiments.disposition: E0 diagnostic, COMPLETE on the full pinned window (2024-07-01..2026-07-01, n=26,969 -- the same population promotion_baseline.json pins). Dispersion 1.68 vs 1.50 threshold and 1.18 resample-noise floor; Spearman(posterior SD, excess Brier) +0.0683 at p=3.0e-29; thin-club SD ratio 1.11. Verdict PROCEED: per-match uncertainty varies and predicts error the point prediction does not already imply, which is the precondition E2 (posterior-variance Kelly) needed and what distinguishes this from the retired variance_inflation. 'promoted' here means the diagnostic is KEPT and its result stands -- it changes no default and moves no price; the only production code it touches is model.fit(row_weights=), inert unless passed. Effect size is small: rho 0.068 says the signal is real, not that E2 will clear its own log-growth gate. See plans/club_soccer_uncertainty_experiment.md
